definitions.full: H4660. mappats [ מַמָּץ ] noun [masculine] shattering ; — מַמָּצוֺ כְּלִי Ezek 9:2 with his shattering-weapon in his hand.

occurrences.englishText: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.
